newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT-Nadro started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Nadro started as buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers initiated coverage of Mexican pharmaceutical company Nadro SA de CV with a buy recommendation, the brokerage said on Friday.
"Mexico's leading distributor of pharmaceuticals has posted outstanding historical operating, efficiency and financial results," retail analyst Deborah Blackhurst said in a report.
She said the company's return on equity in 1996 was 30.3 percent, and operating income was 47 percent higher than its main competitor Grupo Casa Autrey.
Salomon Brothers estimated earnings for Nadro in 1997 of 2.05 pesos per share, and 2.51 pesos in 1998.

Blackhurst said the industry is an attractive one because of expected market share gains from consolidation, possible continued price increases, and growth potential in the health and beauty aids market.
Nadro shares last traded on March 25 at 28.50 pesos.
